title: LangSmith Evaluation Integration
summary: This module provides tools and configurations for integrating LangSmith evaluation capabilities into LangChain applications. It enables running models or chains against datasets and collecting performance metrics.

nodes.label: LangSmith Client
nodes.title: LangSmith Client
nodes.description: Interacts with the LangSmith platform for logging, data management, and feedback.

nodes.label: Evaluation Dataset
nodes.title: Evaluation Dataset
nodes.description: Provides examples and reference data for model evaluation runs.

nodes.label: Model/Chain Under Test
nodes.title: Model/Chain Under Test
nodes.description: The Language Model or LangChain Chain whose performance is being evaluated.

nodes.label: Runnable Configuration
nodes.title: Runnable Configuration
nodes.description: Configures execution parameters for runnables, including callbacks and concurrency.

nodes.label: Evaluator Callback Handler
nodes.title: Evaluator Callback Handler
nodes.description: Collects and logs evaluation results from individual runs to LangSmith.

nodes.label: LangChain Tracer
nodes.title: LangChain Tracer
nodes.description: Records and sends detailed execution traces of runs to LangSmith.

nodes.label: Base String Evaluator
nodes.title: Base String Evaluator
nodes.description: An abstract interface for evaluators that compare string-based outputs.

nodes.label: Labeled Score String Config
nodes.title: Labeled Score String Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation based on a labeled score string, part of LangSmith evaluation configurations.

nodes.label: Labeled Criteria Config
nodes.title: Labeled Criteria Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation against specific criteria with reference answers, for LangSmith.

nodes.label: Embedding Distance Config
nodes.title: Embedding Distance Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation using embedding similarity metrics, for LangSmith.

nodes.label: String Distance Config
nodes.title: String Distance Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation using various string distance algorithms, for LangSmith.

nodes.label: QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: QA Evaluator Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for question-answering tasks within LangSmith.

nodes.label: Context QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: Context QA Evaluator Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for context-aware question-answering in LangSmith.

nodes.label: CoT QA Evaluator Config
nodes.title: CoT QA Evaluator Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for Chain-of-Thought based question-answering in LangSmith.

nodes.label: JSON Validity Config
nodes.title: JSON Validity Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for checking JSON output validity in LangSmith.

nodes.label: Exact Match Config
nodes.title: Exact Match Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for exact string matches, with ignore options, for LangSmith.

nodes.label: Regex Match Config
nodes.title: Regex Match Config
nodes.description: Defines evaluation for string matches using regular expressions, for LangSmith.

nodes.label: Dataset Run Container
nodes.title: Dataset Run Container
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle, state, and result aggregation for an evaluation run over a dataset.

nodes.label: Run Evaluation (Sync)
nodes.title: Run Evaluation (Sync)
nodes.description: Synchronously initiates and manages the evaluation of a model/chain across a dataset.

nodes.label: Run Evaluation (Async)
nodes.title: Run Evaluation (Async)
nodes.description: Asynchronously initiates and manages the evaluation of a model/chain across a dataset.

nodes.label: Execute LLM/Chain
nodes.title: Execute LLM/Chain
nodes.description: Handles the execution of a single LLM or Chain instance during an evaluation run.

nodes.label: String Run Evaluator Chain
nodes.title: String Run Evaluator Chain
nodes.description: A LangChain Chain that adapts a StringEvaluator to process LangSmith Run objects.
